excerpts.text: After more than seven years of development, the company behind RethinkDB is shutting down. We worked very hard to make RethinkDB successful, but in spite of all our efforts we were ultimately unable to build a sustainable business.
Both projects will continue to be available, distributed under open source licenses.

claims.text: In its 2016-10-05 announcement, the company behind RethinkDB said it was shutting down after more than seven years of development and had been unable to build a sustainable business.
The RethinkDB shutdown announcement said RethinkDB and Horizon would continue to be available under open-source licenses.

excerpts.text:
These two rules, thou must have always in a readiness. First, do
nothing at all, but what reason proceeding from that regal and supreme
part, shall for the good and benefit of men, suggest unto thee. And
secondly, if any man that is present shall be able to rectify thee or to
turn thee from some erroneous persuasion, that thou be always ready to
change thy mind, and this change to proceed, not from any respect of any
pleasure or credit thereon depending, but always from some probable
apparent ground of justice, or of some public good thereby to be
furthered; or from some other such inducement.
excerpts.locator: Fourth Book, X (section numbering in this edition)

claims.text: In this translation, Aurelius urges readiness to revise mistaken beliefs on reasonable grounds and to act for the common benefit.

excerpts.text:
The creed which accepts as the foundation of morals, Utility, or the
Greatest Happiness Principle, holds that actions are right in proportion
as they tend to promote happiness, wrong as they tend to produce the
reverse of happiness. By happiness is intended pleasure, and the
absence of pain; by unhappiness, pain, and the privation of pleasure.

claims.text: Mill presents a utilitarian position connecting right action with promoting happiness and reducing pain.
